articles.title: Colorado burger chain getting a makeover
articles.summary: One of Colorado's oldest burger chains is getting a makeover. Golden-based Good Times Restaurants Inc., which owns and operates Good Times Burgers & Frozen Custard and Bad Daddy’s Burger Bar, has enlisted the help of an advertising agency to breathe new life into Good Times Burgers’ nearly four-decade-old brand. Ryan Zink, CEO of Good Times, said Denver-based Cultivator Advertising & Design is working with his company to change the brand's color palette, logo and tagline.
